title: post.tagged v1 payload
description: Someone was tagged in a post (wave 2C). One event per tagged person, emitted by post's consumer of its own post.created (tagged_ids) or post.updated (new_tagged_ids), so never for a draft or a scheduled post before it is published. recipient can open the post, is still tagged, and is not blocked either way with the author. Behind POST_EMIT_TAG_EVENTS.
